verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Qdrant policy, setting, or contractual statement that customer data is excluded from AI model training, and no opt-out control. Self-hosting options (Docker, Private Cloud, Edge) and the security features (API keys, TLS, audit logging) are related controls, but they are not a documented training-data commitment, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
